title: Micro Pattern: Client Intake Evidence Packet

parent_level_mapping.meso: group packet concepts into claim-ready bundles
parent_level_mapping.macro: roll up packet signal quality into portfolio metrics

invariant_preservation_rules.identity: retain CON-900001 and intake_evidence_packet label across levels
invariant_preservation_rules.boundary: keep packet inside internal trust boundary and approved source zones
invariant_preservation_rules.state_transition: promote only from active packet state to governed bundle states
invariant_preservation_rules.evidence: carry source-level citations and provenance pointers unchanged
invariant_preservation_rules.governance: require reviewer policy checks before meso aggregation
invariant_preservation_rules.feedback: capture retrieval misses and adjudication notes for re-ingest
